Res.Caption: Penalty Type
Res.FullDescription: Container penalty type for use of container beyond free time period

Res.Caption: Creditor Type
Res.FullDescription: Type of organization penalty charges are due (carrier, CTO, transport provider)

Res.Caption: Creditor Org.
Res.FullDescription: Code of organization penalty charges are due to

Res.Caption: Location
Res.FullDescription: Location port where detention, storage or wait time occurred

Res.Caption: Free Time Period
Res.FullDescription: Period (days/time) allocated by supplier for free use of a container or free wait time

Res.Caption: Penalty Duration Period
Res.FullDescription: Period of use of container beyond allocated free time period

Res.Caption: Unit of Period
Res.FullDescription: Unit of measure of free time and penalty duration period in days or hours

Res.Caption: Override Cost Per Unit
Res.FullDescription: Charge amount per unit of period (day/hour) in storage, detention, waiting (if amount is fixed per unit)

Res.Caption: Override Total Cost
Res.FullDescription: Total penalty charge for storage, detention, truck wait time

Res.Caption: First Free Day
Res.FullDescription: First day for free use of container

Res.Caption: Last Free Day
Res.FullDescription: Last day for free use of container before penalty is charged

Res.Caption: Elapsed Free Time
Res.FullDescription: Period (days/time) from the First Free Day to now (if less than Free Time)

Res.Caption: Elapsed Duration
Res.FullDescription: Period (days/time) from the day after Last Free Day to now (if Duration is zero)
